title: AcrossWAM1.0:A Modular Latent World-Action Stack for Compact Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2608.29937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world-action models avoid rendering future pixels by predicting an action-relevant visual subgoal in feature space. LaWAM established this formulation, but its original presentation left the world model, multimodal backbone, and deployment checkpoint tightly coupled. We introduce AcrossWAM1.0, a modularization and scaling study of this latent world-action stack. Rather than presenting latent subgoals as a new algorithm, we make the module boundary explicit: a policy adapter produces latent-action and action-generation contexts; a retained latent world decoder grounds the predicted transition in the current scene;and a flow-matching expert generates continuous action chunks. We further separate training-only teachers from the inference graph and provide a verifiable deployment export. translated_title: AcrossWAM1.0：面向紧凑型机器人策略的模块化潜在世界-动作堆栈
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.29937v1 公告类型：新。摘要：潜在世界-动作模型通过在特征空间中预测与动作相关的视觉子目标，避免了渲染未来像素。LaWAM 确立了这一范式，但其原始表述将世界模型、多模态骨干网络和部署检查点紧密耦合在一起。我们提出 AcrossWAM1.0，这是对这一潜在世界-动作堆栈的模块化与缩放研究。我们并非将潜在子目标作为一种新算法提出，而是使模块边界显式化：策略适配器生成潜在动作上下文和动作生成上下文；保留的潜在世界解码器将预测的状态转移锚定在当前场景中；流匹配专家生成连续的动作块。我们进一步将仅用于训练的教师模型与推理图分离，并提供可验证的部署导出。在 2,000 组配对的 LIBERO 轨迹上，将 Qwen3-VL-2B 骨干网络替换为 Qwen3.5-0.8B 后，成功率达到 97.45%，而 2B 模型为 98.00%（相差 -0.55 个百分点
tldr: AcrossWAM1.0 将潜在世界-动作模型显式解耦为策略适配器、潜在世界解码器和流匹配动作专家三个模块，并证明用 0.8B 的小型骨干即可在 LIBERO 上取得接近 2B 模型的成功率（97.45% 对 98.00%）。
en_tdlr: AcrossWAM1.0 explicitly modularizes the latent world-action stack into a policy adapter, a latent world decoder, and a flow-matching action expert, demonstrating that a compact 0.8B backbone achieves near-parity success with a 2B model on LIBERO (97.45% vs 98.00%).
